description: This class defines various analyzers to be used in Hibernate Search mappings within the OpenMRS platform. It provides constants for different types of analyzers such as phrase, start, exact, anywhere, soundex, and name analyzers, which facilitate search functionality on entities like PersonName.

classes.name: SearchAnalysis
classes.description: A utility class that provides constant string identifiers for different Lucene analyzers used in Hibernate Search mappings.
